title: Spec reconciliation: retire four false status assertions surfaced by phase-level verification
description:
Route through /iterate (DEC-016 — every edit is spec body text). Phase-level verification found the spec asserting states the built system contradicts, each baked into a pinned section fingerprint and therefore INVISIBLE to drift detection (FR-052 class).

(1) SHARPEST: § Data Architecture line 297 states silver_eusupplyshares is 'planned (task-038), not yet built' and line 300 states 'the EU table is orphaned at the silver boundary — bronze_to_silver.Notebook reads only the Global table, so bronze_eu_supply_shares has no silver consumer today'. Both FALSE: task-038 closed 2026-08-05; bronze_to_silver.Notebook line 336 reads bronze_eu_supply_shares and line 372 writes silver_eusupplyshares; live fact_supply_share holds 903 rows at supply_mix='eu_sourcing' (vs 2560 global) with t spanning 0.8-1.5. A reader would conclude the EU-sourcing half of DEC-001 Option B was never built.

(2) § Current State Assessment lines 931-934 list task-006_3, task-010, task-012_5, task-036 as incomplete; § Next Steps line 1589 states all four closed. Direct intra-spec contradiction.

(3) § Performance Optimization line 1262 'Pipeline Runtime: Not benchmarked' vs two FINAL benchmark docs with 6 measured runs — and those docs quote the stale line BACK as their rationale, a citation loop that will keep it alive. Lines 1272/1276 also leave task-012_3 items unchecked though it is Finished.

(4) § Development Workflow lines 1013-1017 still claim 'Notebooks use both hyphens and underscores' and 'Some artifact names use camelCase (copyjob1)', contradicted by line 995 in the SAME section and by live workspace enumeration (22 items, no copyjob1).

Also in the same pass: § Orchestration documents 3 pipeline parameters but live+repo carry 5 (p_epi_year, p_execution_id undocumented, and p_epi_year is load-bearing for the EPI vintage chain); § Semantic Model names measures 'Total Spend'/'Supplier Count'/'Total Quantity'/'YoY Growth' but the live model has 'Total Spend EUR'/'Supplier Countries Count' and NO Total Quantity or YoY Growth (verified against a complete 45-measure enumeration); § Data Quality line 1113 and § Testing Strategy line 1302 attribute test data to 'SQL scripts in /azure/' which are DDL-only (zero INSERT statements); § Expected Data Profiles line 1115 says '~500 records' where the verified count is 132.
acceptanceCriteria: § Data Architecture no longer describes silver_eusupplyshares as unbuilt or bronze_eu_supply_shares as having no silver consumer; the text matches the live 903-row eu_sourcing reality and cites task-038 as closed.
§ Current State Assessment and § Next Steps agree on the status of task-006_3, task-010, task-012_5 and task-036.
§ Performance Optimization no longer says 'Not benchmarked'; it cites the two FINAL benchmark documents, and task-012_3's completed items are checked.
§ Development Workflow 'Consistency Issues' no longer contradicts line 995's Phase-5 snake_case reconciliation; copyjob1 is not claimed to exist.
§ Orchestration documents all 5 pipeline parameters including p_epi_year and p_execution_id.
§ Semantic Model measure names match a live enumeration; no measure is named that does not exist.
The '~500 records' and '/azure/ test data' claims are corrected to 132 and DDL-only respectively.
All edits landed via /iterate with an approved change declaration — no direct spec writes.
notes: CREATED 2026-08-05 by phase-level verification (result: pass, 13/13 criteria). Phase acceptance passed; spec coherence did not.
Every item is spec body text -> DEC-016 gated -> /iterate only. Do NOT direct-edit.
Related open friction: FR-052 (the generalising mechanism), FR-054/055/056 (design_contradiction), FR-058 (terminology_mismatch), FR-059 (spec_implementation_gap).

STATUS -> BLOCKED 2026-08-06 (orchestrator, disclosed to Erik). Not a change in scope, priority or difficulty — this task remains the highest-value fix in the queue. It is Blocked because its ONLY route is a command Claude cannot invoke: every edit is spec body text, DEC-016 routes it through /iterate, and /iterate carries disable-model-invocation. Erik must type it.

WHY THE STATUS CHANGE RATHER THAN LEAVING IT PENDING: /work Step 3 case 10 dispatches any Pending owner:'claude' task with satisfied dependencies, and per FB-100 only Blocked/On Hold stops that — user_review_pending does not. Left Pending, the next /work would route an agent at a task whose every deliverable is a forbidden direct spec edit, which either stalls on the permissions.ask gate or produces a DEC-016 violation. This project has already fired that exact foot-gun twice on task-006_3 (2026-07-28 and 2026-08-02). Blocked is the honest state and prevents a third.

UNBLOCKS ON: Erik running /iterate. At that point set back to In Progress and work it as the change declaration. The same gate covers the spec + decision-record half of task-058 (5 spec refs + 3 decision records of its 14), so both should land in one /iterate pass.

UNBLOCKED + IMPLEMENTED 2026-08-06 via /iterate (Erik typed it; approved the batch with a bare 'y', resolving N1-N5 as listed). All 8 acceptanceCriteria addressed. EVERY claim was re-verified against current spec text plus live/measured reality before proposing — task-059's lesson applied — and TWO of this task's own assumptions turned out WRONG:

  (a) THE CONSISTENCY-ISSUES BLOCK WAS NOT SIMPLY FALSE. This task asserted it was contradicted by live enumeration. `copyjob1` is indeed absent (22 items enumerated, positive control passed), BUT 'Notebooks use both hyphens and underscores' is STILL LITERALLY TRUE — `sample-quality-data` is a live hyphenated notebook. Had I deleted the block as instructed I would have replaced one false statement with another. Approved as N2 and replaced with measured notes: the REAL inconsistency is `fact_*` (3 tables) carrying no `gold_` prefix while the other 20 gold-layer tables do — which is what the old 'mixes bronze_/silver_/gold_dim_ prefixes' text was fumbling toward. Also names `mapping_*`, `Notebook_1`, and records that camelCase survives only in Fabric-generated + deliberate names.

  (b) THE PHANTOM MEASURES APPEARED IN TWO PLACES, not one. This task named only § Semantic Model. A post-edit sweep caught `Total Quantity = SUM` still present once — § Business Logic & Calculations carries a SECOND 'Key measures' list naming FIVE non-existent measures (`Total Spend`, `Total Quantity`, `Avg Unit Price`, `Supplier Count`, `YoY Spend Growth`). Fixed both, then cross-checked mechanically: 45 live measures, 11 spec-named, ZERO named-but-absent. Without the sweep the AC would have read satisfied while half the defect remained.

THREE ITEMS FOLDED IN beyond this task's scope (approved as N3, all the same FR-052 class, all surfaced this session): § Orchestration's 'first morning firing is unobserved until 2026-08-06' -> now OBSERVED (run df0cc54f, 04:00:01.24Z = 06:00:01 CEST, 22.6 min, Scheduled 1->2); § Data Quality's '12 check functions' -> 14, naming the two omitted task-026 additions (lookup_name_uniqueness, grain_uniqueness) and stating that BOTH are in BLOCKING_CHECKS, so the spec had been understating its own halt conditions (FR-060); § Next Steps' 'Phase-level verification has not yet run' -> ran 2026-08-05 and PASSED 13/13.

EVIDENCE GATHERED FIRST, not asserted: 903 eu_sourcing rows + 2560 global (3463 total, t 0.80-1.50) read from the live Delta log; bronze_to_silver L336 reads the EU table and L372 writes silver_eusupplyshares; all 4 'incomplete' tasks Finished+verified; /azure/ = 2 files, INSERT=0 CREATE TABLE=1 each; 132 procurement rows; 5 live pipeline parameters via getDefinition; 45 measures from TMDL; 22 workspace items; 39 lakehouse tables. N4 honoured — Batch C is recorded as the one open naming item WITH its constraint (underscore-adding form; a case-only rename is a silent metastore no-op) but WITHOUT deciding it, so Erik's open question stays open rather than resolved by implication.

No version bump (N1): every change corrects a false statement about what already exists — zero scope change. Post-apply per /iterate Step 5: frontmatter `updated:` bumped to 2026-08-06 FIRST, then the spec index regenerated (fingerprint 3909f351 -> 0ca3d5da, index == spec, confirmed fresh). No new `## ` sections, so no pending_decomposition marker needed. Verification sweep: 13 stale phrasings now return 0 occurrences, 12 new phrasings present.

VERIFICATION FAIL 2026-08-06 (attempt 1) — A REAL MISS, and an instructive one. § Next Steps item 3 (line 1609) still read 'First 06:00 scheduled firing is unobserved until 2026-08-06', sitting inside the list headed 'What remains is verification and hygiene' — so it asserted as REMAINING something this same pass proved DONE, and its own cross-reference landed on § Orchestration text now saying the opposite. Identical defect shape to this task's own numbered item (2): a direct intra-spec contradiction. It was three lines below the paragraph I rewrote and visible as diff context.

ROOT CAUSE OF THE MISS: my verification sweep grepped the 13 PHRASINGS I HAD CHANGED and confirmed they returned 0. It never grepped for status WORDS generally, so a stale assertion using vocabulary I had not touched was invisible to it. Sweeping the phrasings you fixed cannot find the ones you didn't. The verifier also correctly noted this falsified my 'Verification sweep: 13 stale phrasings now return 0 occurrences' claim — `grep -c unobserved` returned 1 (its positive control: Europe/Stockholm returned 2 on the same file). And because FR-052 is precisely 'a false status assertion baked into a pinned section fingerprint is invisible to drift detection', passing this would have re-baked one.

REMEDIATED, plus a proper sweep this time. Item 3 now records the confirmed firing (run df0cc54f, 04:00:01.24Z, 22.6 min, Scheduled 1->2) and agrees with § Orchestration. Re-swept on status WORDS rather than changed phrasings: unobserved 0, 'Not benchmarked' 0, 'has not yet run' 0; the surviving 'not yet' (1) is the warehouse gold->oem_wh sync, which is GENUINELY unorchestrated (no pipeline activity exists) and must stay; the surviving 'never built' and 'orphaned' hits are a true statement about the absent YoY measure and an unrelated DQ check description. Also audited all 8 remaining unchecked boxes — all genuinely open. Positive control on every probe.

TWO MINORS ALSO FIXED, both refinements to text I authored in this pass under the approved N2/Change 6 (same-change accuracy, not new scope): (a) the concatenated-names note implied only the two silver supply tables, but four more read as concatenated — bronze_epi2024results/weights, silver_epi2024results/variables — which are DELIBERATE (they derive from the p_epi_year contract) and must not be 'fixed'; that is now stated so a reader globbing for concatenated names does not renamed them and break the parameterised chain. (b) 'Report Usage Metrics *' was called camelCase when it is Title Case with spaces, the StagingLakehouseForDataflows_* glob missed the live StagingWarehouseForDataflows_*, and report2 was unaccounted for — all three corrected.

VERIFIER CONFIRMATIONS WORTH RECORDING: it independently re-derived nearly everything against live Fabric and explicitly endorsed the N2 deviation ('the implementer's call was CORRECT and I would have made the same one' — deleting the block as this task instructed would have swapped one false statement for another). It confirmed 5 parameters / 10 activities via getDefinition; the 06:00 run to the digit; 45 measures with ZERO named-but-absent across BOTH lists, calling the post-edit sweep that found the second list load-bearing; fact_* exactly 3 vs gold_* exactly 20; mapping_* exactly 2; copyjob1 absent with a same-universe positive control; INSERT=0 in both azure scripts; 14 DQ checks with BOTH task-026 additions genuinely in BLOCKING_CHECKS; frontmatter-before-index ordering correct (index == spec fingerprint); and it AGREED with N1 (no version bump) and confirmed N4 was honoured (Batch C recorded as open without being decided). Index refreshed again after this remediation — b080c54a, index == spec.

VERIFICATION FAIL 2026-08-06 (attempt 2). Two majors, both legitimate, and the second is worse than the first because I INTRODUCED it.

MAJOR 1 — A THIRD INSTANCE OF THE SAME CLAIM. Line 416 (§ Data Transformations -> Output Tables) still read '`silver_eusupplyshares` *(planned — task-038)*', cross-referencing the very § Data Architecture paragraph this pass rewrote to say 'Both halves of DEC-001 Option B are live.' So the spec said 'planned' and 'live' about the same table, three sections apart, with a pointer from the false claim to the true one. Same subject as this task's own item (1) — the one it called SHARPEST.
  MY REPEATED ROOT CAUSE: ad-hoc sweep vocabulary, twice. Attempt 1's sweep covered only the phrasings I had CHANGED. Attempt 2's sweep covered status WORDS — but I improvised the word list and omitted bare 'planned', which is exactly where instance 3 lived. Fixing the vocabulary after each miss is not a method; it is whack-a-mole. THIS TIME I ran a CANONICAL fixed-vocabulary sweep (planned / pending / not yet / unobserved / currently / remains / none yet / TBD / outstanding / upcoming / will be, plus the unchecked-box glob) with a positive control on every probe, and then eyeball-audited EVERY surviving hit rather than trusting the counts.

MAJOR 2 — I INTRODUCED A CONTRADICTION IN MY OWN NEW TEXT, and it violated the very decision N4 protected. My § Development Workflow rewrite called the concatenated silver tables 'the one open naming item' and labelled `OEMInsightBI_v2` / `report2` 'deliberate project names'. Both false: docs/standards/naming_standards.md says the live model is 'slated to drop the `_v2` suffix' and prescribes `OEMInsightBI` / `oem_report`, and docs/architecture/fabric-artifacts-inventory.md L104 flags both as 'Phase 5 rename targets'. No decision record retires those targets. So I (a) contradicted two project docs and (b) resolved part of Erik's open naming question BY IMPLICATION — precisely what N4 was written to prevent. Cause: I enumerated the live workspace and reasoned about which names LOOKED deliberate, without checking whether the project had already documented an intent for them. Live-state enumeration is not a substitute for reading the standards doc.
  FIXED WITHOUT DECIDING, per N4: the text now records BOTH open naming families — the concatenated silver tables AND the `_v2`/`2` suffixes — cites both docs, states that no decision record retires the targets, and explicitly says neither is decided here. It also keeps the true part (Fabric artifacts deliberately follow PascalCase per naming_standards.md; the SUFFIXES are what remain open), so the correction does not overshoot into a new falsehood.

FOUR MINORS ALSO FIXED, all verified by measurement first: (a) L284/L376 said WGI Year/Value are 'currently' dropped while appending 'corrected by task-031' — self-contradicting present tense; task-031 closed 2026-07-23 and bronze_to_silver now hard-requires those columns, so both are reworded as historical. (b) The claim that all 8 unchecked boxes were genuinely open was FALSE for 2: measured 45 tests in test_data_quality.py (box ticked, citing the 9->12->14 expansion) and 7 MATERIAL_ALIASES tests in test_material_mapping.py — that box is now marked PARTIAL with the honest gap named (country aliases have ZERO coverage; positive control: the same probe found MATERIAL_ALIASES in tests/, country_alias nowhere). (c) § Testing Strategy said 235 tests; now 282 as of 2026-08-06, and the 235 inside the phase-verification record is date-qualified as what was true THEN rather than falsified. (d) The § Next Steps header 'What remains is verification and hygiene' no longer described its own list once items 1 and 3 became records of completed work — reworded to 'Verification and hygiene status'.

FINAL SWEEP RESULT: every surviving status-word hit eyeball-audited and legitimate — WB indicator rows genuinely not produced (562/571/574), warehouse gold->oem_wh sync genuinely unorchestrated (675; verifier independently confirmed zero oem_wh references in the pipeline against an oem_lh control), push notifications descoped (705), 13 BLOCKING_CHECKS entries (1115), pipeline integration tests genuinely none (1312), SCD Type 1 (1549), and the one remaining 'never built' is the true statement about the absent YoY measure. Index regenerated, index == spec. 282 tests pass.

VERIFIER CREDIT: it found instance 3 by constructing its OWN sweep vocabulary rather than reusing mine, and it caught the '- [ ]' probe silently returning 0 because the spec uses three spaces ('-   [ ]') — its positive control is the only reason that did not become a false 'zero unchecked boxes' finding.

VERIFICATION FAIL 2026-08-06 (attempt 3) -> ESCALATED per the 3-attempt limit. Three attempts, three misses, EACH EXACTLY ONE INSTANCE. That pattern is the finding.

ATTEMPT 3's INSTANCE (L244, § Data Sources -> EPI 'Single-vintage caveat') carried FOUR false claims: that bronze_to_silver names bronze_epi2024results/silver_epi2024results 'literally (lines 74, 108)'; that changing the vintage 'breaks the chain rather than moving it'; that BLOCKING_CHECKS holds a literal "oem_lh.silver_epi2024results"; and that 'task-042 carries the parameterization'. All four verified false: bronze_to_silver L46 declares p_epi_year, L206 reads f"...bronze_epi{p_epi_year}results", L267 writes f'silver_epi{p_epi_year}results' with ZERO literals; data_quality_checks derives all five EPI names from EPI_YEAR including the BLOCKING_CHECKS entry at L1993; and task-042 is Finished/pass 2026-07-26 — its own TITLE is 'bronze-to-silver still hardcodes bronze_epi2024results', i.e. that was the defect it FIXED, 11 days before this pass. It also directly contradicted text I authored in this same pass at L697 ('re-points the whole EPI chain').

THE REAL LESSON, and the verifier named it better than I had: THE VOCABULARY WAS NEVER THE BINDING CONSTRAINT. I treated three successive misses as a word-list problem — phrasings I changed (attempt 1), then improvised status words (attempt 2), then a 'canonical' vocabulary (attempt 3). Every iteration was still a guess about which WORDS a stale claim might use. The deterministic method is structural, not lexical: MECHANICALLY CROSS-REFERENCE EVERY task-ID MENTIONED IN THE SPEC AGAINST THAT TASK'S STATUS, including .claude/tasks/archive/ where 75 of 82 task files live (a live-directory-only glob yields a false 'task not found'). I ran it: 82-task map, positive control resolving, and L244 was the ONLY line in the entire spec asserting open work for a Finished task. It would have been found on attempt 1 in one pass. Filed as a verification_failure marker.

REMEDIATED: L244 rewritten to describe the actual single-sourced state, enumerating the parameter at each hop, and RETAINING the caveat that still matters (a stale BLOCKING_CHECKS table name does not error — it silently demotes the check to advisory, which is precisely why the entry is derived). Two minors also fixed: the country-alias table is `mapping_country_aliases_confidence` (I had written `mapping_country_alias`, which exists nowhere; verified against silver_to_gold L422 and 4 docs), and the empty WB DataFrame is at ~L1236 not L883 (verified: `wb_vars = spark.createDataFrame(`).

POST-FIX DETERMINISTIC CHECK IS CLEAN: the task-ID cross-reference now returns only my own retraction prose describing the former false state, plus the 'both halves are live' statement — no assertions of open work. Index regenerated (a475793a), index == spec. 282 tests pass.

ESCALATION DECISION FOR ERIK: 3 attempts is the protocol limit, so I am not self-authorizing a 4th verification. All 8 ACs are literally satisfied and have been re-derived against live Fabric across three independent verifications; every finding was a residual instance of the class rather than an AC miss. The choice is (a) run a 4th verification, or (b) accept on the deterministic evidence and let the standing task-ID cross-reference guard catch any recurrence. My recommendation is (b) — the method that kept failing has been replaced by one that is structural rather than lexical, and it now returns clean.

SEPARATE CONSEQUENCE OF THIS SESSION, surfaced by the verifier: .claude/verification-result.json still pins spec_fingerprint 3909f351 while the spec is now a475793a, so THE PHASE-LEVEL PASS IS FINGERPRINT-INVALIDATED and phase re-verification is owed once the fix queue closes. That is the correct, expected consequence of editing the spec — not a defect — but it must not be forgotten: /work routing will call for it.

ACCEPTED BY ERIK 2026-08-06, resolving the 3-attempt escalation. Recorded honestly as USER ACCEPTANCE, not as an agent pass — the last verify-agent run returned FAIL, on an instance that has since been fixed, and fabricating a pass record would defeat the point of a structurally-enforced gate. The acceptance basis is written into task_verification.acceptance_basis: three independent verifications all confirmed the 8 ACs, every FAIL was a residual class instance rather than an AC miss, all four instances are fixed, and the structural task-ID cross-reference that replaced the failing lexical sweeps returns clean.

WHAT THIS PASS ACTUALLY LANDED: 16 corrections to spec_v1.md across 12 sections. The headline — the spec no longer tells a reader that a live 903-row EU-sourcing feature was never built (it said so in TWO places), no longer claims the pipeline is unbenchmarked while two FINAL benchmark docs quote that very line back as their rationale, no longer names four measures that do not exist in the model (in TWO separate lists), no longer understates its own DQ blocking checks, and no longer describes the EPI vintage chain as hardcoded when task-042 parameterised it 11 days earlier.

STANDING GUARD for the next session: the defect class is not retired by this pass, only its current instances. The durable protection is the deterministic check — for every task-ID mentioned in the spec, compare against that task's status across BOTH .claude/tasks/ and .claude/tasks/archive/ (75 of 82 files live in the archive; a live-only glob yields a false 'task not found'), and flag any line pairing a Finished/Absorbed task with incomplete-flavoured wording. Filed as a verification_failure marker recommending it become an /audit-coherence lens.

verification_history.summary: FAIL on consistency_check. All 8 ACs satisfied and nearly every new claim independently re-derived against live Fabric. Failed on ONE residual defect of exactly the class this task exists to retire, three lines below a paragraph the same pass rewrote.

FAIL on consistency_check + spec_alignment. Two majors: a THIRD instance of the same stale claim (line 416), and text authored in this pass that reclassified two documented-open rename targets as deliberate.

FAIL on consistency_check. A FOURTH FR-052 instance at L244 (§ Data Sources → EPI): four false claims about EPI vintage hardcoding, all fixed by task-042 which closed 2026-07-26. All 8 ACs literally satisfied; failure was a residual class instance.

task_verification.verified_by: USER ACCEPTANCE (Erik, 2026-08-06) resolving a 3-attempt verification escalation — NOT an agent pass
task_verification.acceptance_basis: Three independent verify-agent runs each confirmed all 8 acceptanceCriteria satisfied and re-derived the underlying facts against live Fabric. Every FAIL was a residual instance of the FR-052 class elsewhere in the spec, never an AC miss. All four instances found across the three attempts are fixed, and the structural check that replaced the failing lexical sweeps — cross-referencing every task-ID in the spec against that task's status, including the archive — returns clean. Erik accepted on that evidence rather than spending a 4th verification.

checks.consistency_check: pass (post-remediation; last agent run failed on an instance since fixed)

evidence.detail: All 8 ACs confirmed satisfied in all three verification reports.

Across attempts: 5 pipeline parameters + 10 activities via getDefinition; run df0cc54f at 04:00:01.24Z with Scheduled count 1->2; 45 TMDL measures with ZERO named-but-absent across BOTH spec measure lists; fact_* exactly 3 vs gold_* exactly 20; mapping_* exactly 2; copyjob1 absent with a same-universe control; INSERT=0 in both azure scripts; 14 DQ checks with both task-026 additions genuinely in BLOCKING_CHECKS; 903 eu_sourcing rows measured by the orchestrator via OneLake.

Task-ID cross-reference over an 82-task map (live + archive) with a positive control: zero spec lines assert open work for a Finished/Absorbed task. The only matches are retraction prose describing former false states.
